pairs.question: Cogitare tamen quis non potest?
pairs.answer: Facile est enim illam figuram quam uidendo cognouimus nigro colore perfundere quem nihilominus in aliis corporibus uidimus.
pairs.derivation: Author asks (after "Quis enim uidit cygnum nigrum? Et propterea nemo meminit.") whether anyone is unable to imagine a black swan, then answers how it is done. The answer ends at the first full stop ("...uidimus."); the following sentence "et quia utrumque sensimus, utrumque meminimus" elaborates and is cut. Dropped the preceding "Quis enim uidit cygnum nigrum?" because its reply "Et propterea nemo meminit" states a consequence rather than directly answering who has seen one.
